soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1; Theorem 3; tldr; project_justification; comparator_promise_table
soundness_flags.one_line: Calling the result a strict assumption weakening of KBRW is unsupported: the proposed fixed global lower density band is an added restriction, while KBRW Theorem 2 has estimator-side density-ratio, Gram, and nuisance conditions, so no displayed class/assumption inclusion establishes strict weakening rather than an alternative tradeoff.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v4 (23 Dec 2023), corroborating preprint; the cited Annals primary was identified but its full text was not extractable from the publisher page
source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4.4, Theorem 2 and Remarks 10–11, especially equations (14)–(15)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The attaining local R-learner has the displayed three-term rate but requires high-level Gram, nuisance-estimator, and density-ratio conditions; its third-order remainder contains the density-estimation error.
The paper introduces a no-sample-splitting stabilized HOIF for bilinear forms and distinguishes it from earlier independent-sample empirical-Gram work.
The paper studies constant conditional-variance estimation under a smooth positive random-design density and uses a cellwise projected close-pair two-scale construction.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace every “strict assumption weakening/tightening” claim with “removes KBRW's density-estimation condition on the fixed positive-band class,” or prove an explicit inclusion between the relevant KBRW upper-bound domain and the proposed class.
State a concrete low-dimensional multiresolution weight family and its resulting open set U as a worked construction; retain the general correction-order derivation as the OEQ.
Make the bank comparison theorem-level: cite stat_cate_density_bottleneck's settled close-pair region and prove U is nonempty, open, disjoint from it, and governed by the same benchmark objective.

recommended_next_step: Revise the KBRW comparison into a formally valid assumption-tradeoff or prove the needed inclusion, then advance the density-free extension angle to Stage 0.
